changelog: Dev build v837. The CSM settings row no longer shows a stale version. The extracted host-menu resource APK was cached under one fixed filename and reused forever, so the row kept the version baked into the first extraction ("CS Manager V 835"). The cache is now revision-scoped (csm-settings-host-res-<versionCode>.apk) and every other revision, including the legacy fixed name, is pruned, so the row always matches the running CSM version after an update and restart. This dev build aggregates all current unpublished source in the shared CSM tree and is not an isolated patch.
message: Dev build v837 - CSM settings row now shows the running version
